I(x)
&=\int_0^1 g(t)\,dt+\int_1^{x+1} g(u)\,du-\int_0^x g(u)\,du\\
&=\int_0^1 \ln f(t)\,dt+\int_0^x\bigl[\ln f(t+1)-\ln f(t)\bigr]dt\\
&=\int_0^1 \ln f(t)\,dt+\int_0^x \ln\frac{f(t+1)}{f(t)}\,dt
\end{aligned}
\]
